title: Vegan Coleslaw
subtitle: Creamy dairy-free coleslaw with vegan mayo
excerpt: A creamy vegan coleslaw made with plant-based mayonnaise, white cabbage, carrot and a little vinegar. Tastes exactly like the classic; indistinguishable at the table.
sourceNotes: Vegan mayonnaise (based on aquafaba or sunflower oil emulsified without eggs) became widely available in UK supermarkets from around 2015, making vegan coleslaw a straightforward substitution for the classic. The formula is identical to the original; only the mayonnaise changes.

recipe.batchNotes: Makes up to 2 days ahead. Flavour improves with a little resting time.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Rest for at least 30 minutes before serving for the flavours to come together.

content.text: Vegan coleslaw uses plant-based mayonnaise in place of the egg-based original. The texture and flavour are indistinguishable at the table. Choose a good-quality vegan mayo (one that lists sunflower oil or rapeseed oil and is smooth rather than watery) and the result will be exactly what you expect from the dish.

Combine the shredded cabbage and grated carrot in a large bowl. Whisk together {{mayonnaise}} of vegan mayo, {{cider-vinegar}} of cider vinegar, {{caster-sugar}} of sugar, {{dijon-mustard}} of Dijon mustard, {{sea-salt-fine}} of salt and {{black-pepper}} of pepper. Pour over the cabbage mixture and toss until evenly coated. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving.

items.fix: Salt the shredded cabbage, leave 20 minutes, then squeeze out moisture before dressing.

items.cause: Some vegan mayos are less thick than egg-based ones.
items.fix: Add an extra tablespoon of mayo. If the brand you have is consistently thin, try a different one next time.

content.text: Classic coleslaw is one of the simplest things to make vegan without any compromise. The plant-based mayo market has matured enough that there are good products in most supermarkets. This version slots into any context where the original would go: alongside burgers, fried food, sandwiches, or on a buffet table.
